title: Uncoded QPSK and 16-QAM over AWGN
description: Scenario 1: uncoded Gray QPSK and 16-QAM over AWGN, BER against the exact closed form.

parameters.timing: one block of 10^6 bits (quick: 2·10^5) at Eb/N0 = 6 dB
parameters.theory: exact BER of Gray square QAM, Cho & Yoon, IEEE Trans. Commun. 50(7), 2002

libraries.comrs: com-rs from Python: the functions of the comrs package, called block by block
libraries.comrs-spec: com-rs from Python: comrs.run_spec, the parallel Monte Carlo runner of Rust
libraries.comrs-rust: com-rs from Rust: the comrs command-line binary on the same specification
libraries.opticommpy-nojit: OptiCommPy without numba (NUMBA_DISABLE_JIT=1: the same @njit kernels run as plain Python)

runs.command: OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 python s1_awgn.py --lib comrs --threads 1 --work results/_work --out results/_work/s1_awgn_comrs_1.json
python s1_awgn.py --lib comrs --threads all --work results/_work --out results/_work/s1_awgn_comrs_all.json --timing-only

OMP_NUM_THREADS=1 OPENBLAS_NUM_THREADS=1 MKL_NUM_THREADS=1 VECLIB_MAXIMUM_THREADS=1 NUMBA_NUM_THREADS=1 RAYON_NUM_THREADS=1 python s1_awgn.py --lib comrs-spec --threads 1 --work results/_work --out results/_work/s1_awgn_comrs-spec_1.json
python s1_awgn.py --lib comrs-spec --threads all --work results/_work --out results/_work/s1_awgn_comrs-spec_all.json --timing-only

timing.workload: 1000000 bits at Eb/N0 = 6.0 dB, 40 trials (process wall time, start-up included)
1000000 bits at Eb/N0 = 6.0 dB, 40 trials (process wall time, start-up included)
